orthopoly.invariant_readout: logpower mean/std,lag1/2 normalized complex correlation,4 positional logpower means
orthopoly.interpretation: Received relative filter/polynomial energy is retained by normalization;not recovered TX PA/IQ coefficients or arbitrary RX/channel invariance
orthopoly.normalization_scope: one complex power mean across all channels and time per packet per block
orthopoly.relative_energy_after_gate: may change through learned radial gate;not fixed
orthopoly.waveform_operator: x[n]exp(-j alpha omega n);raw variant returns x exactly
orthopoly.alignment_interpretation: fixed received frequency retention;not TX/RX oscillator proportion
orthopoly.behavior_input: weighted centered envelope and second orthogonal polynomial; raw clipped z retained
orthopoly.projection_scope: same packet, same lag, closed-form IQ-only moments; no fitting objective or persistent state
orthopoly.packet_future_scope: full received256packet moments, same scope as RMS; not streaming causal projection
orthopoly.orthogonality_scope: within each same-packet lag/order input block when nondegenerate; not all12crosslag or classes

orthopoly_contract.packet_future_scope: full received256packet moments, same scope as RMS; not streaming causal projection
orthopoly_contract.orthogonality_scope: within each same-packet lag/order input block when nondegenerate; not all12crosslag or classes
